questionText: An array $[82, 101, 90, 11, 111, 75, 33, 131, 44, 93]$ is heapified. Which one of the following options represents the first three elements in the heapified array?
explanation:
To build a Max-Heap (heapify) bottom-up from an array of size $N = 10$, we start processing non-leaf nodes from index $\lfloor N/2 \rfloor = 5$ down to index $1$ (1-based indexing).

Initial Array: $[82, 101, 90, 11, 111, 75, 33, 131, 44, 93]$

Step 1: Heapify Node 5 (value = 111)
Child is at index $10$ (value $93$). Since $111 > 93$, no change.

Step 2: Heapify Node 4 (value = 11)
Children are at indices $8$ ($131$) and $9$ ($44$). The largest child is $131$. Swap $11$ and $131$.
Array becomes: $[82, 101, 90, 131, 111, 75, 33, 11, 44, 93]$

Step 3: Heapify Node 3 (value = 90)
Children are at indices $6$ ($75$) and $7$ ($33$). Since $90 > 75$ and $90 > 33$, no change.

Step 4: Heapify Node 2 (value = 101)
Children are at indices $4$ ($131$) and $5$ ($111$). The largest child is $131$. Swap $101$ and $131$.
Array becomes: $[82, 131, 90, 101, 111, 75, 33, 11, 44, 93]$

Step 5: Heapify Node 1 (value = 82)
1. Children of root are $131$ (index $2$) and $90$ (index $3$). Swap $82$ and $131$.
Array becomes: $[131, 82, 90, 101, 111, 75, 33, 11, 44, 93]$
2. Heapify down at index $2$ ($82$): Children are $101$ (index $4$) and $111$ (index $5$). Swap $82$ and $111$.
Array becomes: $[131, 111, 90, 101, 82, 75, 33, 11, 44, 93]$
3. Heapify down at index $5$ ($82$): Child is $93$ (index $10$). Swap $82$ and $93$.
Final Array: $[131, 111, 90, 101, 93, 75, 33, 11, 44, 82]$

The first three elements in the heapified array are 131, 111, 90.
